newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels say moving into Kisangani city.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels say moving into Kisangani city.

text.p: Zaire rebels battling for the country's third largest city of Kisangani said on Saturday their forces were advancing into the city itself after overrunning the international airport.
"The international airport has been taken and fighting is continuing in town," Raphael Ngenda told reporters at rebel headquarters in the eastern town of Goma.
